title: Democratic wins could slow AI investment and safeguard the US economy against a downturn by pacing it over time, as Deutsche Bank sees "shaky" projects killed (Cecile Daurat/Bloomberg)
summary: Cecile Daurat / Bloomberg: Democratic wins could slow AI investment and safeguard the US economy against a downturn by pacing it over time, as Deutsche Bank sees “shaky” projects killed — Guardrails against data-center expansion in states won by Democrats may help spread investment over time.
